
## ZX Spectrum Next (+3DOS wrapped)

`ECHO.god` and `nextras.god` are copied from `apps/dev/Zeus` of the ZX Spectrum Next distribution (tbblue repository): sources
saved by Zeus on the Next, in a +3DOS file (the 128-byte header `PLUS3DOS`, then the same line records the 1983 codec reads).
`nextras.god` is the list of the Z80N opcode names Zeus defines for `DEFB NEXTX,MUL`.
